customManagers.description: versions.yaml single source of truth (D42): bump the annotated `current` pins; a `tag@sha256:` pin gets its digest moved with its tag (issue 833)

packageRules.description: Group GitHub Actions bumps into one PR
Group non-major dev-time updates to keep noise down
uv moves as one PR: versions.yaml (GitHub release) plus the uv image the scanner Dockerfiles copy from, which check-versions.sh holds equal
Node moves as one PR: versions.yaml plus each CI setup-node, which check-versions.sh holds equal and the github-actions group would otherwise take
OpenSearch moves as one PR: versions.yaml plus every consumer check-versions.sh checks, including the CI service images the github-actions group would otherwise take
The javv-opensearch chart's dependency on the official opensearch chart joins the opensearch PR, and the copy vendored in its charts/ folder is refreshed in the same PR
ruff moves as one PR: versions.yaml, each pyproject.toml pin and the pre-commit hook, which check-versions.sh holds equal
Grype is bumped in versions.yaml only: the Dockerfile writes it v-prefixed in FROM, so after the bump run check-versions.sh --fix on the PR
Grype moves as one PR: the scanner version and the scanner-images self-scan pin in versions.yaml, which check-versions.sh holds equal
Stay on Python 3.12 (requires-python, the scanner images, .python-version) until a deliberate upgrade

The Dockerfiles' python and node bases and the uv image stay pinned by digest; Renovate re-pins one if an edit (check-versions.sh --fix) drops the digest. Dockerfiles only: the pyenv manager reads .python-version with the same datasource, and a digest there would break it
The app's own images in the compose file move with each release: release-please bumps their tags, not Renovate

Majors wait for a tick on the Dependency Dashboard: the MVP ships on the current majors, and they are taken one at a time before 1.0. Minor, patch, lockfile and security updates still open on their own
